entries.title: AFCI
entries.meaning: Detects certain arcing faults; distinct from GFCI protection.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: AFUE
entries.meaning: Seasonal useful heat output as a fraction of fuel energy input; not the percentage of fuel chemically burned.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: AHJ
entries.meaning: The responsible authority for the address, work and code family; county boundaries alone may not identify the permit authority.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: AUX / emergency heat
entries.meaning: Control-dependent modes; identify the actual equipment sequence and record each mode tested.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: AWG
entries.meaning: Conductor-size designation. Material, insulation, terminals and application still govern suitability.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Balance point / lockout
entries.meaning: A thermal balance point is not the same as an operating cutoff or fuel-cost switching choice.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Bearing / connection
entries.meaning: Bearing transfers load at a support surface; a connection secures or transfers forces between members. Both need context.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: BOCA / CABO
entries.meaning: Building Officials and Code Administrators / Council of American Building Officials. The historical local record must identify the particular code and edition.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Cantilever
entries.meaning: A member extending beyond its support. Backspan, connection and loads affect the assembly.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Capillary action
entries.meaning: Liquid movement through fine pores or narrow spaces; distinguish it from bulk runoff and vapor transport.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: CO
entries.meaning: Toxic combustion gas; a combustible-gas detector and a CO instrument serve different purposes.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Code / standard / general practice
entries.meaning: Adopted legal requirements, referenced technical provisions and customary practice have different authority and scope. Keep the qualifier attached.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Collar tie / rafter tie
entries.meaning: Upper ties and lower ties serve different functions and locations; identify the complete roof design.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Condensing equipment
entries.meaning: Equipment designed to recover heat as water vapor condenses; requires compatible venting and condensate arrangements.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: COP
entries.meaning: Heat output divided by energy input at stated conditions; not a seasonal bill prediction.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: COURSE / EXAM
entries.meaning: Training statement / recorded assessment concept. Neither alone establishes current local requirements.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Cross-connection / air gap
entries.meaning: A cross-connection can expose supply water to contamination; an air gap is a physical separation used in appropriate protection arrangements.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: CSST
entries.meaning: Fuel-gas distribution tubing; distinguish product type, bonding requirements and appliance connectors.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Dielectric connection
entries.meaning: A suitable connection limits direct electrical contact between dissimilar metals. Thread tape alone is not a listed dielectric fitting.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Differential movement
entries.meaning: Parts of an assembly move by different amounts; crack patterns alone do not establish the cause or whether movement is active.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Draft hood / barometric damper
entries.meaning: A gas draft hood and a swinging barometric regulator have different arrangements; match the appliance, fuel and vent system.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: DWV
entries.meaning: Piping that carries waste and admits air; separate from the potable supply and relief piping.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Efflorescence
entries.meaning: Surface salts left as moisture evaporates; evidence of moisture transport, not proof of an active leak at the visit.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: EIFS
entries.meaning: Exterior wall finish assembly; distinguish its layers and drainage details from conventional stucco.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: EMT
entries.meaning: A raceway; verify fittings and suitability for the exposure.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Evaporator / condenser
entries.meaning: Names describe the current coil function; heat-pump mode can change which coil performs it.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: EVSE / EV-ready
search_labels: Electric vehicle supply equipment / charging provision
entries.meaning: Installed charging equipment differs from provisions for future equipment. Read the applicable statute, permit scope and actual labels.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: FAC
entries.meaning: Final fuel-gas connection to an appliance; not interchangeable with CSST distribution tubing.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Facing / covering
entries.meaning: Plaster or board may support paint, wallpaper or another finish; observed layers do not disclose all hidden work.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Fascia / soffit / frieze
entries.meaning: Fascia follows the roof edge; soffit is the underside of an overhang; frieze is trim near the top of the wall.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Flood opening / air vent
entries.meaning: Flood openings address hydrostatic pressure equalization; ventilation openings address air movement. Do not use one label for both.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Footing / foundation
entries.meaning: A footing spreads loads to supporting ground; the foundation transfers building loads to its support. Identify the visible assembly.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Functional flow / drainage
entries.meaning: Flow concerns usable supply while fixtures operate; drainage concerns waste leaving fixtures. Record the actual test and response.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: FVIR
entries.meaning: A product feature; does not by itself settle every garage installation requirement.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: GFCI
entries.meaning: Protection against certain ground-fault shock hazards; a successful test does not certify the whole circuit.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Grade / retaining wall
entries.meaning: Grade is the ground slope/elevation; a retaining wall supports a difference in ground level. Trace drainage and visible movement.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Gravity / forced air
entries.meaning: Gravity uses natural air circulation; forced air uses a blower. Neither term establishes combustion venting type.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Grazing light
search_labels: Light nearly parallel to a surface
entries.meaning: Shows shadows at bulges, sags, seams and repairs; the shape does not by itself diagnose the cause.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Ground loop / desuperheater
entries.meaning: A buried heat-exchange circuit differs from an optional circuit recovering heat for domestic water.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Grounding / bonding
entries.meaning: Grounding connects to earth; bonding joins conductive parts to establish the intended electrical continuity and fault-current path.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Heat exchanger
entries.meaning: Transfers heat between streams while intended to keep combustion products separate from the distributed heating medium. Visibility is limited.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Heat pump
entries.meaning: Moves heat between source and sink; identify modes, controls and supplemental heat.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Home inspection / code compliance
entries.meaning: An inspection reports observed conditions within its scope; it does not by itself certify compliance with every applicable construction requirement.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: HRV / ERV
entries.meaning: HRV recovers heat between airstreams; ERV also transfers moisture. Actual airflow and recovery performance are separate questions.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: HTPV
entries.meaning: Legacy vent-product category; check product markings and the specific CPSC recall application. Not every plastic vent is recalled.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: IBC / IRC
search_labels: International Building Code / International Residential Code
entries.meaning: Different code scopes; establish which applies to the building and work, with local amendments.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: IC / IC-AT
entries.meaning: Insulation-contact / insulation-contact with air-tight designation. Verify the actual product and installation conditions, not paint color.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: IECC / IEBC
search_labels: International Energy Conservation Code / International Existing Building Code
entries.meaning: Energy and existing-building provisions have distinct scopes and adoption histories.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: IPC / IMC / IFGC
search_labels: International Plumbing / Mechanical / Fuel Gas Code
entries.meaning: Separate code families; local adoption and amendments may differ.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Joist / beam / girder
entries.meaning: Joists commonly carry floor/decking loads to beams or girders; confirm actual bearing and connection, not just member size.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Lath / plaster key
entries.meaning: Lath supports plaster; keys form through openings. Loose overhead material is not a probing target.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Ledger / guard / handrail
entries.meaning: Ledger transfers deck loads to a support; guard limits falls at an edge; handrail provides a graspable support.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Load path
entries.meaning: Route by which loads pass through connected members and bearing points to the foundation and ground.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: MCA / maximum OCP
search_labels: Minimum circuit ampacity / maximum overcurrent protection
entries.meaning: Distinct equipment-label quantities; neither follows directly from nominal tonnage.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Model edition / effective date
entries.meaning: A model-code publication year does not establish when a locality applied it. Record adoption, effective date and permit transition separately.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: MWBC
entries.meaning: A circuit arrangement sharing a neutral; supply legs and disconnect provisions matter.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: NEC / NFPA 70
entries.meaning: Two identifiers for the electrical code; distinguish the edition from local adoption and enforcement dates.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: NFPA
entries.meaning: Standards publisher. NFPA 1, 54, 70 and 101 address different subjects; the organization name alone is not a requirement citation.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: NM cable
entries.meaning: Cable with a nonmetallic outer sheath; check marking and application, including moisture exposure.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Notch / bored hole
entries.meaning: An edge cut and an enclosed hole affect a member differently; use the applicable member-specific limits.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: NOTE / LOCAL
entries.meaning: Reviewed explanation or correction / jurisdiction-specific qualification requiring the stated scope.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Plenum
entries.meaning: A chamber connecting the air handler or furnace to distribution ductwork; location follows the actual equipment orientation.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Post-tensioned slab
entries.meaning: Tendons stressed after concrete placement; drilling or cutting can intersect concealed stressed tendons.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Rafter / truss
entries.meaning: An individual sloping member versus an interconnected designed assembly. Do not apply ordinary rafter alteration assumptions to a truss.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Rake / eave
entries.meaning: Rake: sloped edge at a gable end. Eave: lower roof edge where runoff normally leaves the plane.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Reversing valve
entries.meaning: Changes refrigerant routing so indoor and outdoor coils can exchange jobs.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Sash / glazing / IGU
entries.meaning: Sash holds glazing; an insulated glass unit combines sealed panes. Distinguish seal failure from surface condensation.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: SEER2 / HSPF2
entries.meaning: Ratings under a specified test procedure; do not treat legacy SEER/HSPF numbers as identical measures.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Spalling
entries.meaning: Flaking, breaking or loss of material at a masonry or concrete surface. Describe location and extent before assigning a cause.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Step / counter / kick-out flashing
entries.meaning: Step pieces interleave with roofing; counterflashing covers an upper flashing edge; a kick-out redirects water at the lower end.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Storm collar / firestop
entries.meaning: A storm collar sheds water at flashing; a listed firestop/support assembly serves its specified penetration. One does not become the other by reversing it.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: T&P / TPR
entries.meaning: Relief protection with distinct temperature and pressure functions; do not confuse it with a pan drain.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Temperature rise
entries.meaning: Supply minus return air temperature under stated operating conditions; compare with the actual furnace label. It does not establish heat-exchanger integrity.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Thermocouple / photocell
entries.meaning: A thermocouple generates a small temperature-related voltage; a photocell senses light. Controls and service procedures are system-specific.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Trap / vent
entries.meaning: A trap retains a water seal; a vent manages air movement in the drainage system. Neither is a supply backflow device.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Truss uplift / rafter spread
entries.meaning: Uplift is upward truss-chord movement; spread is outward movement at rafter supports. Similar finish cracks require surrounding evidence.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: U-factor / SHGC
entries.meaning: U-factor describes heat transfer; solar heat gain coefficient describes admitted solar heat. Keep units, climate and label context.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Vapor retarder
entries.meaning: Material that limits water-vapor diffusion. Its presence alone does not establish a complete moisture-control system.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Veneer
entries.meaning: A facing supported and attached to another assembly; distinguish it from structural masonry.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: Weep / drainage plane
entries.meaning: A weep is an opening for drainage; the drainage plane is the path behind the cladding. A visible hole does not establish the concealed path.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.

entries.title: WRB
entries.meaning: Layer within the wall water-control assembly; its continuity and integration with flashing matter.
entries.label_relationship: Expanded name or component of a paired definition; paired terms are not asserted synonyms.
